407:t_1:5.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Look, $$レド$$! Look at this mountain of treasure!」

407:t_1:7.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Cheer up a little. You wiped out the $$クジライカ$$s, and I got my hands on the treasure like this, didn't I.」

407:t_1:8.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Now my big brother will be happy too, I bet.」

407:t_1:10.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「...Come to think of it, I never told you. How I knew there was treasure down there.」

407:t_1:11.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「My big brother dove down there a long time ago. He's the one who found that stuff there.」

407:t_1:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「...Dead. He made a $$クジライカ$$ angry.」

407:t_1:15.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「It was just like my brother said. Treasure like this lies sleeping here in endless supply.」

407:t_1:16.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$フランジ$$ says he wants to use this stuff to change the fleet's way of life, but that can wait.」

407:t_1:17.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「First I'll take care of the pirates and the $$サイデリアル$$ who are enemies of the $$ガルガンティア船団$$!」

407:t_1:19.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「From now on I'm a proper ship owner too! ...I'm $$ピニオン$$ of the $$霧の海$$! Anyone who gets in my way gets taken care of by the power of treasure!」

407:t_1:20.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「There was even a beam cannon in the treasure! The mechanic skills I honed with $c are itching to get to work!」

407:t_1:22.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「...Did something happen to you?」

407:t_1:24.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「If you feel like it, go say hello to $c. Tell them we'll be doing things our way from now on.」

407:t_1:25.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「They're 20 kilometers from here. $$エイミー$$ is there too, so at least show your face.」

407:t_1:27.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Anyway, I've got salvage to direct, so I'm off. I'm counting on you from now on too, $$レド$$.」

407:t_1:29.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「A fact has been discovered that backs up the recorded footage of the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

407:t_1:30.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The Light Bugs are nanomachines, effectively the same as the outer shell of the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$. They absorb electromagnetic waves and convert them to energy with high efficiency.」

407:t_1:31.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「At the same time, they replicate themselves and, through pseudo-carbon bonding, also function as a sturdy exoskeleton.」

407:t_1:32.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「They can also optimize their surroundings, and the purification of the oceans contaminated by the disaster in the footage is presumed to be their doing.」

407:t_1:33.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This is proof that the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are the outcome of humanity's arbitrary evolution, and...」

407:t_1:34.en:
$$レド$$
「Why are you like this!? The meaning of the $$銀河同盟$$'s... of my fight has been completely denied!」

407:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
「And there's still more I don't understand! The name $$シャア・アズナブル$$ came up in that data too!」

407:t_1:36.en:
$$レド$$
「Was that the Colonel $$シャア$$ I know!?」

407:t_1:37.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Inference is impossible at this time.」

407:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
「There's nothing but things I don't understand...! In this state, I...」

407:t_1:39.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「An error is recognized in your perception.」

407:t_1:40.en:
$$レド$$
「If the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are evolved humanity... can I fight them!? Is there any meaning in fighting!?」

407:t_1:41.en:
$$レド$$
「...If there isn't... I can't fight... I can't kill those creatures...」

407:t_1:42.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Unacceptable. Your perception negates the reason for existence of both you and this unit.」

407:t_1:43.en:
$$レド$$
「You saw it too, didn't you!? The newborn $$クジライカ$$...!」

407:t_1:44.en:
$$レド$$
「Humans are killing humans! That's what our war really is!」

407:t_1:45.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Even with that information, there is no reason to abandon the annihilation of the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

407:t_1:46.en:
$$レド$$
「There's none for YOU, that's all! For me...」

407:t_1:47.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Negative. The fundamental ruin the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ would bring upon humanity... Averting that is your sole mission.」

407:t_1:48.en:
$$レド$$
「They're both humanity, aren't they!? I've had enough of the Alliance's slogans!」

407:t_1:49.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Negative. This unit's parallel link with the Alliance has been lost. This is a conclusion from information analysis this unit conducted independently.」

407:t_1:51.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Humanity and the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ can never be reconciled. The reason is that they are beings that have negated civilization itself.」

407:t_1:53.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「If humanity had possessed a tough, all-purpose body like the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, there would have been no need to develop $$マシンキャリバー$$s in the first place.」

407:t_1:54.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit's system is a crystallization of human wisdom. The same applies to each of the airframes of $c, developed by various civilizations.」

407:t_1:56.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「But that was needed by humans to compensate for their fragile bodies.」

407:t_1:57.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I infer that humans developed intellect and built civilization in order to surpass their own limits.」

407:t_1:58.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The existence of civilization is precisely why humanity is the crown of creation. However, the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, who cast off the human form, have no physical limits.」

407:t_1:59.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「If one merely pursued happiness and satisfaction as a living organism, intellect would not necessarily need to be advanced.」

407:t_1:60.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$マシンキャリバー$$s are humanity's sole foundation for remaining human. In other words, a crystallization of pure intellect produced by civilization.」

407:t_1:61.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「And the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, by overcoming even that intellect, have reached one ultimate extreme of life as an organism.」

407:t_1:62.en:
$$レド$$
「You're saying they're the ultimate life form, the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$...」

407:t_1:63.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Therefore you must fight alongside this unit for the dignity of humanity.」

407:t_1:64.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「In a conflict between those who share the same root, defeat means immediate extinction.」

407:t_1:65.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Pursuing civilization versus abandoning it. The war between the $$人類銀河同盟$$ and the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is a clash of two different survival strategies, and...」

407:t_1:66.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The loser can only await being weeded out.」

407:t_1:68.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Viewed as a battle for survival between parties that cannot be reconciled, the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are unmistakably classified as $$バアル$$.」

407:t_1:69.en:
$$レド$$
「Then are you saying everyone in $c can fight even after learning what the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ really are!?」

407:t_1:70.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Affirmative. In fact, they have also experienced wars between humans.」

407:t_1:71.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「You too took part in them as a member of $c.」

407:t_1:72.en:
$$レド$$
「...That's because I agreed with what they were doing.」

407:t_1:73.en:
$$レド$$
「But the Alliance is different. That way of living was all I had... With no affirming or denying it...!」

407:t_1:74.en:
$$レド$$
「Even so, in my heart there was pride that I was fighting for humanity. Now that it's been completely shattered, I...」

407:t_1:75.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「As long as you desire survival, there is no room for choice.」

407:t_1:76.en:
$$レド$$
「You're forcing me to fight? You, a machine... to me, a human...」

407:t_1:77.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am a Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface System. I fulfill my reason for existing when you obtain more results.」

407:t_1:82.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Briefing Room ～

407:t_1:84.en:
$$ルカ$$
「None. It seems he's refusing even our communications.」

407:t_1:85.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「He's probably on a mission as a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$, not as a member of $c.」
